cambios.s: Texto de la carta
Dear WSPS Hiring Team,
I'm applying for the Web Systems Developer role. I live in London, Ontario, and your mission is close to the work I've been doing lately.

This fall I built an inspection platform for a two-site greenhouse operation near London. Their health and safety team had dropped their previous tool because it didn't work without signal inside the greenhouses. I gathered requirements with Health & Safety and HR, read through the OHSA, WSIB and JHSC obligations, and shipped an offline-first web app that about 30 people piloted. Every finding gets an owner and is tracked to corrective action, with audit logs nobody can edit. That project taught me safety software only works if people on the floor actually use it.

Most of what the posting describes is work I already do. At Delphi I helped move a WordPress site to Next.js, and Lighthouse Performance went from 45 to 90 along with SEO and accessibility fixes. At Kruger I led the order module of a logistics platform handling 5,000+ shipments a day, so production support, monitoring with Datadog and Sentry, and reading logs when something broke were part of the job. On my own projects I run a headless Shopify store connected through GraphQL APIs and webhooks, keep a prioritized backlog, and write ADRs so the next developer knows why things were built that way.

Some of your stack would be new to me, mainly Azure DevOps, Craft CMS and Coveo. I've worked with PostgreSQL and MySQL for years, plus Jira, CI/CD pipelines and WordPress, so I expect the ramp-up to be short.
I'd like to talk about your website roadmap and how I could help Digital Marketing ship improvements with less friction. Thank you for your time.
